facts.fact: 叙述者 Spanish 因不了解土壤、气候和虫害，为自家老橡树请来一位树木医生（arborist）。
facts.anchor: Because she didn’t know the soil, climate, or insect populations, she had called in this arborist.

facts.fact: 名片上写着「Shelby Mathews，树木医生」，但他没有进屋，也没有喝茶或威士忌。
facts.anchor: The tree doctor—Shelby Mathews, Arborist, his card said—had not come into Spanish’s new log home,

facts.fact: Spanish 的爷爷教会她「用触摸认识世界，就是用心认识世界」。
facts.anchor: To know the world by touch is to know it by heart.

facts.fact: 修女们却教她「触摸是魔鬼的」，要求她双手合拢、戴白手套、不碰泥土不碰男孩。
facts.anchor: Touch was of the devil—the lesson the nuns taught.

facts.fact: Spanish 把混血西班牙猎犬 Dragon 关进阁楼，像外婆当年在药师来之前把狗拴远一样。
facts.anchor: She had also closed her mixed-blood spaniel, Dragon, in the loft with chews, just in case.

facts.fact: Spanish 家正与联邦政府打官司：T-Metals 被允许砍伐她家传统土地旁的森林。
facts.anchor: The messy lawsuit against the U.S. government—ongoing—that had allowed T-Metals to clear-cut the forest that abutted her family’s traditional homelands.

facts.fact: 剪枝后她鼓起勇气请 Shelby 进屋喝咖啡或热巧克力，他答应了。
facts.anchor: “Come in for coffee or hot chocolate while I write you a check?”

facts.fact: Shelby 说他第一天就看见了烟草——她为橡树做了供奉，像鸻鸟用翅膀遮住幼鸟一样小心翼翼。
